title: 타이핑 한 글자마다 랜더가 되어서 계속 새 줄이뜬다.

triage_metadata.reasoning: The reporter provides a clear and actionable bug report describing terminal UI redraw issues where typing each character in the interactive prompt appends a new line instead of redrawing in-place. Client environment metadata (CLI 0.35.3, macOS Darwin 24.11.1) is included.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Resolving terminal redraw flickering and new line spamming during input handling requires debugging React/Ink state updates, cursor position calculations in InputPrompt, and stdio stream/line wrapping configurations in interactiveCli.tsx.

summary.problem: Every typed character in the interactive CLI prompt triggers a terminal re-render that appends a new line instead of updating in-place.
summary.root_cause: When handling input events in the interactive prompt, React state updates in InputPrompt trigger Ink re-renders. If terminal dimensions, line wrapping, or stdio streams fail to handle ANSI cursor move/clear sequences properly, Ink falls back to appending new lines on every state change.
summary.context: The issue occurs on macOS Darwin v24.11.1 with CLI version 0.35.3 in terminals where Kitty Keyboard Protocol is unsupported or terminal dimensions/line-wrapping settings interfere with Ink's diffing/redrawing mechanism.

steps: Investigate stdio stream proxying and terminal line wrapping options in interactiveCli.tsx during Ink initialization.
Ensure disableLineWrapping and enableLineWrapping correctly synchronize with Ink's terminal buffer and stdout stream state during input events.
Optimize InputPrompt input state updates and visual buffer calculations to avoid unnecessary re-renders or erroneous height recalculations on every keystroke.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Typing characters into the prompt buffer updates the input text in-place on the same line without spawning new lines or triggering full terminal redraws.
verification_steps: Run unit tests in packages/cli/src/ui/components/InputPrompt.test.tsx using Vitest.
Simulate sequential keypress events in InputPrompt and verify that character additions update the active line without appending extra newline characters to the terminal buffer output.
